CodeQL query that flags tile union member accesses in mismatched tile source files.

# Purpose
This CodeQL query detects a tile union type mismatch in C and C++ source files. It looks for field accesses to a union member that belongs to a specific tile variant, then checks whether the file name matches the expected tile name pattern. The query is narrow in scope and is intended as a static analysis rule for finding a possible bug in code that uses tile-specific union members.
